method: Pooled 1D 2-means, CONSTRAINED exact optimal contiguous-partition solution (not Lloyd's algorithm / not percentile-initialized): for one-dimensional data the optimal 2-cluster WCSS-minimizing partition is always a contiguous split of sorted values; found here via exhaustive vectorized search over every split point satisfying a minimum-cluster-size constraint on BOTH sides. Fit on ALL valid, non-null, one-minute TRAIN-split appliance readings (not window-subsampled) from the four development households (7901, 7951, 8565, 3538), enforced by an explicit whitelist. Household 8386 (held-out unseen test household) excluded.
minimum_cluster_size_calculation: min_size = max(1, ceil(minimum_cluster_fraction * n_valid)), computed independently per appliance from that appliance's own valid-reading count (n_valid); applied SYMMETRICALLY -- neither the low nor the high cluster may contain fewer than min_size readings. Rounds UP (ceiling), never down, so the constraint is never accidentally weaker than requested.
tie_breaking: Deterministic: among all split points tied for minimum total within-cluster sum of squares, the smallest split index (ascending order) is selected -- i.e. the smallest resulting threshold on ties. No randomness anywhere in the computation.
minimum_cluster_fraction_rationale_and_l: 0.1% was chosen after a read-only sensitivity sweep (0.01%-1.0%) on the real four-development-household training data: results were identical and stable across 0.01%-0.5% (a 50x range) for all three appliances (true minority ON fractions observed: 0.64%-41.6%), and only degraded at 1.0% once it exceeded the smallest observed minority fraction (dishwasher1, 0.64%). 0.1% sits inside that stable range with margin on both sides. This is a documented ASSUMPTION based on the appliances examined here, not a provably universal constant -- a future appliance with a true ON fraction rarer than ~0.1% of valid training minutes would require this floor to be revisited.
decision_rule: label = 1 (ON) if valid non-null target >= threshold; label = 0 (OFF) if valid non-null target < threshold; label = null if target is invalid or null
units_limitation: The physical unit of the source appliance readings (kW vs W) could not be verified from any documentation available in this project (archive contains only a directory entry, the main CSV, and metadata.csv; no unit string was found in any of them). Thresholds are expressed and applied in the dataset's original, unconverted measurement units. No unit conversion or unit assumption (kW or W) is made anywhere in this script.
approved_by: explicit user approval, revised split: dev-homes-only pooled 2-means thresholds

superseded_thresholds_original_5home_fit.note: Original pooled 1D 2-means fit across all five homes (including the now-held-out household 8386) on window_index_train.parquet stride-5 window endpoints. Superseded because (a) it let 8386's training-period data influence a threshold now applied against 8386 as the unseen test household, and (b) it fit on subsampled window endpoints rather than the full per-minute training signal.
